newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle at $69, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle at $69, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade turned moderate after a slow start in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,100 slaughter steers and 600 slaughter heifers; 23,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Confirmed - 1,700
